title: Change the storefront's settings
caption: Mirrors settings-effects.e2e.ts (primary colour, 40 offers per search). One PATCH per section with If-Match; the API deletes t:<tenantId>:<env>:sf:* itself.

steps.title: Brand and theme
steps.body: Primary colour `#7c2d12` (text or picker); watch the preview and the contrast verdict; **Save branding and theme**.
steps.expect: "Saved. The storefront shows the change within 5 minutes."; version + 1; the storefront's `--vx-primary` changes once the tab's 5-minute copy is forgotten.

steps.title: A failing contrast
steps.body: Type a light primary such as `#f0f0f0`.
steps.expect: The failing pair is named before saving (the storefront would fall back).

steps.title: Offers per search
steps.body: **Offers per search** 40, **Save search**; then **Use the default** and **Save search**.
steps.expect: Next storefront search asks Amadeus `max=40` (check `/supplier-log`), then `max=150`; saving the same value again: "Nothing to save: the offers per search are as shown." and no call.

steps.title: Policies and payments
steps.body: Ticketing policy, 3-D Secure, card brands, TTLs; the airline card in TEST.
steps.expect: The live airline card box is disabled with the security-review reason while the platform switch is off.

steps.title: Read-only roles
steps.expect: Every field disabled, no **Save**; no settings row in `staff_actions`.
